title: 2023年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 Team-building exercises have become popular for managers trying to increase organisational and team harmony and productivity. Unfortunately many employees resent compulsory bonding and often regard these exercises as a nuisance.

P2 A paper published this week by University of Sydney researchers in Social Networks has reported participants' feelings about team-building interventions(干预), revealing ethical implications in forcing employees to take part.

P3 "Many people see team-building activities as a waste of time, so we decided to look in more depth at what's behind this," said the paper's lead researcher, Dr. Peter Matous.

P4 "Teams are formed, combined and restructured. Staff are relocated and office spaces redesigned. All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency, collaboration and cohesion. But does any of this work?" said Dr. Matous.

P5 The study found that team-building exercises which focused on the sharing of and intervening into personal attitudes and relationships between team members were considered too heavy-handed and intrusive, although the researchers say some degree of openness and vulnerability is often necessary to make deep, effective connections with colleagues.

P6 "Some participants were against team-building exercises because they were implicitly compulsory. They didn't welcome management's interest in their lives beyond their direct work performance," said Matous. "Many people don't want to be forced into having fun or making friends, especially not on top of their busy jobs. They feel management is being too nosy or trying to control their lives too much."

P7 In this study the researchers recommended a self-disclosure(表露) approach where participants were guided through a series of questions that allowed them to increasingly disclose personal information and values. The method is well-tested and has been shown to increase interpersonal closeness. However, to be successful it must be voluntary.

P8 The researchers said there are numerous schools of thought that propose differing psychological methods for strengthening relationships. "With caution, many relational methods to improve teams and organisations can be borrowed from other fields. The question is how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective, which is more than just the sum of individual relationships," said Dr. Matous.

questions.q: Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises?
options: They consider such exercises annoying.
They deem these exercises counter-productive.
They see such exercises as harmful to harmony.
They find these exercises too demanding.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises? 用 Why 提问，问的是 原文已写明的具体理由，不需要跨段推理。

【拆句】题干 Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises? 是一般疑问句， 主干为员工反对团建练习，be opposed to 是固定搭配表示反对、抵触，结构平铺直叙，无 陷阱。

【定位】Unfortunately many employees resent compulsory bonding and often regard these exercises as a nuisance. 遗憾的是，许多员工反感被强制团建，并常把这些练习视为一种麻烦。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 regard these exercises as a nuisance ↔consider such exercises annoying resent ↔annoying 预判员工嫌团建烦人，They consider such exercises annoying 正是定位句 regard these exercises as a nuisance 的同义改写，故锁定该项。 B) 无中生有 counter-productive 指适得其反、降低生产力，原文只说员工嫌烦，从未说团建会起反 作用，属凭空添加。 C) 与原文相反 harmful to harmony 称团建有害于和谐，但原文 increase organisational and team harmony 说团建本意是增进和谐，选项把目的反说成危害。 D) 答非所问 too demanding 指要求过高、太费力，这是 on top of their busy jobs 一带而过的另 一层意思，并非第 46 题问的反对的主要原因。 46. Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises? A) They consider such exercises annoying. B) They deem these exercises counter-productive. C) They see such exercises as harmful to harmony. D) They find these exercises too demanding. Matous博士和他的团队做了什么来查明团队建设活动是否能提高生产力? A) 他们重新安置了团队领导及其办公室。 B) 他们重新安排了员工和办公空间。 C) 他们重新设计了员工的工作时间表。 D) 他们重新引入了一些凝聚性活动。

questions.q: What did Dr. Matous and his team do to find out whether team-building activities would improve
options: They relocated team leaders and their offices.
They rearranged the staff and office spaces.
They redesigned the staff's work schedules.
They reintroduced some cohesive activities.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did Dr. Matous and his team do 问的是研究团队具体做了什么，答案是原文明写的 动作清单，属事实查找。

【拆句】题干主干是 What did Dr. Matous and his team do，后接不定式目的状语 to find out whether...，其中 whether 引导宾语从句表示是否提升效率；理清主干问做法、状语说目 的，即无障碍。

【定位】Teams are formed, combined and restructured. Staff are relocated and office spaces redesigned. All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency, collaboration and cohesion. 团队被组建、合并、重组。员工被调岗，办公空间被重新设计。所有这些都是为了提升工作 效率、协作与凝聚力。

【选项】A) 以偏概全 relocated team leaders 只说调动了团队领导，而原文 Staff are relocated 指全体员 工，选项把范围悄悄缩小到领导一类人。 B) ✓ 正确 Staff are relocated ↔rearranged the staff office spaces redesigned ↔office spaces 预判为调动员工与办公空间，They rearranged the staff and office spaces 把两个动 作合并改写，与定位句一一对应，故锁定该项。 C) 偷换概念 redesigned the staff's work schedules 说重新设计的是工作日程，但原文 redesigned 的对象是 office spaces 办公空间，选项偷换了被改造的对象。 D) 无中生有 reintroduced some cohesive activities 说重新引入凝聚性活动，原文从未提及重新引 入活动这一动作，纯属添加。 47. What did Dr. Matous and his team do to find out whether team-building activities would improve productivity? A) They relocated team leaders and their offices. B) They rearranged the staff and office spaces. C) They redesigned the staff's work schedules. D) They reintroduced some cohesive activities. Matous团队的研究对一些团队建设活动有什么发现? A) 它们旨在分享个人态度和关系。 B) 它们隐含地增加了团队成员的脆弱性。 C) 它们总是加强了同事之间的联系。 D) 它们被视为对员工私人生活的侵扰。

questions.q: What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises?
options: They were intended to share personal attitudes and relationships.
They implicitly added to the vulnerability of team members.
They invariably strengthened connections among colleagues.
They were regarded as an intrusion into employees' private lives.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises? 问的 是研究已写明的发现，可直接定位明文结论，属细节查找。

【拆句】题干 What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises? 主干为研究发现了什么，about 引出对象范围；注意 some 限定的是部分团建练习而非全 部，是本题理解关键。

【定位】The study found that team-building exercises which focused on the sharing of and intervening into personal attitudes and relationships between team members were considered too heavy- handed and intrusive, although the researchers say some degree of openness and vulnerability is often necessary to make deep, effective connections with colleagues. 研究发现，那些聚焦于分享并干预团队成员个人态度与关系的团建练习，被认为过于强硬且 具有侵入性，尽管研究者表示，某种程度的开放与脆弱往往是与同事建立深层有效联系所必 需的。 48. What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises? A) They were intended to share personal attitudes and relationships. B) They implicitly added to the vulnerability of team members. C) They invariably strengthened connections among colleagues. D) They were regarded as an intrusion into employees' private lives.

【选项】A) 答非所问 intended to share personal attitudes and relationships 说团建意在分享个人态度关 系，但 focused on the sharing of... 是研究者对这类团建特征的客观描述，且本题问的 是研究的发现而非团建的意图。 B) 与原文相反 added to the vulnerability 称团建增加了成员的脆弱，但原文 some degree of...vulnerability is often necessary 说一定程度的脆弱是建立联系所必需的，并非团建 恶意制造脆弱。 C) 过度推断 invariably strengthened connections 说团建无一例外地增进了联系，但原文只说脆 弱开放是建立联系所必需的前提，且整段强调这类团建被嫌侵入，并未说它总能增进 联系。 D) ✓ 正确 intrusive ↔an intrusion into employees' private lives interest in their lives beyond their direct work performance ↔into employees' private lives 预判某团建被嫌强硬侵入，They were regarded as an intrusion into employees' private lives 把 intrusive 与 P6 对私生活的窥探合并改写，完全对应。 自我披露方法如何能够成功增进人际亲密度? A) 通过允许参与者自由表达自己。 B) 通过将其应用于自愿参与的员工。 C) 通过恰当安排参与者面对的问题顺序。 D) 通过引导员工完成团队建设中的一系列步骤。

questions.q: How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness?
options: By allowing participants freedom to express themselves.
By applying it to employees who volunteer to participate.
By arranging in proper order the questions participants face.
By guiding employees through a series of steps in team building.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness? 问的是原文明写的成功前提，可直接定位，属细节题。

【拆句】题干 How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness? 主干问该方法如何才能成功，succeed in doing 是固定搭配表示成功做到某 事；结构清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】The method is well-tested and has been shown to increase interpersonal closeness. However, to be successful it must be voluntary. 该方法经过充分检验，已被证明能增进人际亲密。然而，要想成功，它必须是自愿的。 49. How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness? A) By allowing participants freedom to express themselves. B) By applying it to employees who volunteer to participate. C) By arranging in proper order the questions participants face. D) By guiding employees through a series of steps in team building.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 freedom to express themselves 说让参与者自由表达，但原文规定的成功条件是 voluntary 自愿参加，而非表达自由，选项偷换了条件的内容。 B) ✓ 正确 it must be voluntary ↔employees who volunteer to participate 预判成功须自愿，By applying it to employees who volunteer to participate 把 voluntary 落实为只对自愿参与者使用，与定位句完全对应。 C) 答非所问 arranging in proper order the questions 说按顺序排好问题，这是 guided through a series of questions 描述的方法本身，而非题干所问的成功前提。 D) 偷换概念 guiding employees through a series of steps in team building 把自我表露法说成团 建中的引导步骤，原文的 a series of questions 是问题不是团建步骤，且仍未触及自愿 这一成功条件。 Matous如何看待从其他领域借鉴的用于加强关系的各种心理学方法? A) 它们必须结合使用才能作用于整个集体。 B) 它们将某些心理方面置于其他方面之上。 C) 它们过于强调个体关系。 D) 它们必须谨慎应用才能有效。

questions.q: What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for
options: They must be used in combination for an entire collective.
They prioritise some psychological aspects over others.
They place too much stress on individual relationships.
They have to be applied cautiously to be effective.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Matous think of the various psychological methods... 虽问看法，但 Matous 的观点在原文引语中已明说，可直接定位，按细节题处理。

【拆句】题干 What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for strengthening relationships? 主干为 Matous 怎么看这些方法，think of 表示对某事的评价，borrowed... 是后置定语修饰 methods；抓住主干即可。

【定位】"With caution, many relational methods to improve teams and organisations can be borrowed from other fields. The question is how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective, which is more than just the sum of individual relationships," said Dr. Matous. Matous 博士说："谨慎地说，许多用于改善团队与组织的关系方法可以从其他领域借鉴。问 题在于如何有效地运用它们来强化一个整体，而这个整体不只是个体关系的简单相加。" 50. What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for strengthening relationships? A) They must be used in combination for an entire collective. B) They prioritise some psychological aspects over others. C) They place too much stress on individual relationships. D) They have to be applied cautiously to be effective.

【选项】A) 过度推断 used in combination for an entire collective 说必须组合使用，但原文 how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective 说的是如何有效运用以强化整 体，并未要求把方法组合起来。 B) 张冠李戴 prioritise some psychological aspects over others 说这些方法偏重某些心理层面， 这呼应的是 numerous schools of thought that propose differing psychological methods，是对各派别的描述，并非 Matous 对借用方法的看法。 C) 与原文相反 place too much stress on individual relationships 说过分强调个体关系，但原文 more than just the sum of individual relationships 恰恰说整体不只是个体关系之 和，提醒不要只看个体，选项把意思说反了。 D) ✓ 正确 With caution ↔applied cautiously how to apply them effectively ↔to be effective 预判须谨慎且讲求有效，They have to be applied cautiously to be effective 同时覆 盖 With caution 与 apply them effectively，故锁定该项。
